idea-plugin.name: Process Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
See running processes, ports and system usage without leaving the IDE.

  • Status bar widget with live CPU / memory, popup with CPU, memory, disk and network graphs
  • "Process Monitor" tool window: list / tree view, search by name, PID, port or working directory
  • "This project" filter: processes whose working directory is inside the current project
  • Kill one or many processes (optionally with all child processes), open listening ports in the browser
  • Run/Debug watcher: when a run fails with "port already in use", shows who holds the port with a "Kill and rerun" action; when a run stops but child processes keep running, offers to kill them

IDE 안에서 실행 중인 프로세스, 포트, CPU·메모리·디스크·네트워크 사용량을 보고 종료할 수 있습니다.
